rec.name: FAQ Accordion Section with Support Intro Block (Variant 1)
rec.status: Built — delivered, documented (Variant 1 = Impact-style layout; tabbed category variant split into a separate ticket)

what.text: A reusable Shopify section 'CRO | FAQ Section' with a two-column card. The left column is an optional intro block (max 1) with a heading, a subline, a row of 4 support-team avatars with a green 'online' dot, and a support availability line (e.g. 'Available Mon–Fri 8am–8:30pm. Average answer time: 24h'). The right column is a grey rounded box holding an accordion of FAQ blocks. Each block is one question with a round chevron toggle and a rich-text answer. On mobile the columns stack and the availability/avatar block moves below the accordion.

why.text: Answering common objections (shipping, returns, account, gift wrapping) right where the buyer hesitates lowers perceived risk and reduces support load. The human avatars, the 'online' dot and the stated response time make support feel approachable and reliable, which builds trust. The accordion keeps the page compact while the answers stay one click away.

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-faq-section.liquid and paste in the supplied code (CSS, markup, vanilla JS, schema). The section has two block types: 'intro' (max 1: heading, heading size, content, 4 avatar images, active-status color, footer title, footer content) and 'faq' (question, rich-text answer, open-by-default checkbox). Colors and radii are exposed as CSS variables set from the section settings. The accordion is a custom <ed-collapsible> structure with a button toggle, aria-controls/aria-expanded, and Web Animations API open/close (500ms). A 'multiple open at once' checkbox controls the single-open behavior. Add the section in the theme editor, add one Intro block and as many FAQ blocks as needed. The code was built against the Impact theme.

items: Allow multiple accordions open at once (checkbox, default on)
Section spacing top/bottom/left/right (desktop) and separate mobile spacing
Intro block: heading, heading size, rich-text content, 4 avatar images, active status dot color, footer title, footer content
FAQ block: question, answer (rich text), open as default

dependencies.text: Built for the Shopify 'Impact' theme: it uses the theme's global settings (heading_color, text_color, background), the 'heading' class and the 'container' width class. No external apps or JS plugins are required. The delivered code file's schema is truncated, so the full block schema is not verified. The original acceptance criteria also asked for categories/tabs, icons per category, a hide-entry option and lazy loading. These are NOT in this variant. Category tabs were moved to a separate Edubily-style ticket.

items: FAQ interaction rate (accordion opens per session)
Conversion rate on pages with the FAQ
Contact/support request rate and support tickets
Bounce/exit rate on PDP and landing pages
Scroll depth to the FAQ section

images.caption: Final UI: intro heading, subline, avatars with online dot and availability text on the left; grey accordion box with FAQ questions on the right
Block structure: one Content (intro) block, max 1 per section, plus multiple FAQ blocks
Theme editor view with the section's settings: multiple-open toggle, width, max-width, colors, radii, and spacing, plus the Intro and FAQ blocks in the sidebar
Reference of the separate Edubily-style tabbed FAQ (category filter tabs), moved to its own ticket, not part of this variant
